title: User Management

hint.createOnly: This only creates the account itself. The new account has no login method yet and must be activated separately before it can log in.
hint.accountImmutable: The account can't be changed after it's created. The email and full name can still be edited later on the edit page.
hint.accountReadonly: Can't be changed in the admin console for now
hint.disabledReadonly: An account's disabled status can't be changed in the admin console for now. The list and this page only show the status, and saving keeps the value as it was when loaded.
hint.loginsReadonly: The following information is read-only. Unlocking, clearing failed attempts, and resetting passwords have no admin endpoints yet and must be handled by the operations team.
hint.roles: You can assign multiple roles. An account without roles has no permissions after logging in.

empty.noRoleDetail: No role assigned. This account has no permissions after logging in.
empty.noLogin: No login method is linked yet, so this account can't log in.
empty.noRolesAvailable: No roles are available to assign. Please create one in Role Management first.

created: User "{account}" created. This account has no login method yet and must be activated separately before it can log in.
roleAssignFailed: User "{account}" was created, but assigning roles failed ({message}). Please assign them again on the edit page.
notFound: The specified user was not found.
roleUpdateFailed: The basic information of user "{account}" was updated, but the roles were not ({message}). Please try again.
loadRolesFailed: Failed to load the role list.
loadRolesFailedRetry: Failed to load the role list. Please try again later.
